TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd will staff this engagement with a dedicated, cross-functional delivery team backed by a 250-person organization with offices in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore and Karachi, enabling on-site workshops and sustained support for State Life’s Principal Office in Karachi. [CO-PROFILE] Governance will be led by PMP-certified project management, with six PMP-certified project managers available to run scope, schedule, risk, and vendor coordination (including the payment gateway) under controlled change management. [CO-PROFILE]

Certifications and process maturity directly align to your mandatory quality and security requirements. We hold ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications as part of our corporate certifications portfolio, and we also operate at CMMI Level 3 for disciplined engineering and delivery practices. [CO-PROFILE] Our delivery track record includes multiple large, recent software and platform implementations exceeding PKR 5M in the last five years—e.g., LMS Development for a Federal Government client (PKR 199M, completed 2022) [CAP-010], ERP Implementation (PKR 93M, completed 2022) [CAP-050], and Cloud Infrastructure for a Federal Government client (PKR 108M, completed 2025). [CAP-012]

Quality assurance for the corporate website and secure customer self-service portal will be executed through our ISO 9001-aligned test planning, traceability, and acceptance sign-off, and ISO 27001-aligned security controls for authentication, role-based access, and secure API and payment integrations. [CO-PROFILE] Our library does not yet evidence WCAG 2.1 AA delivery; we will address this via dedicated accessibility reviews, assisted testing, and an independent audit before go-live.

For one-year support, we provide an in-country support desk with 24–48 hour response SLAs and can provide preventive maintenance on O&M contracts, aligned to your warranty/support expectations. [CO-PROFILE]
